# Results

*Generated by `tools/results_table.py` from `docs/results.csv` and `docs/results-phase9.csv`. Do not edit by hand: rerun `python3 tools/bench/run_all.py`, then the generator.*

Measured on Apple M5, 10 cores, 16 GiB, macOS 26.6.2, measured 2026-10-03 on battery power. Real `raftkvd` processes on one machine, driven by `raftkvload` (closed-loop clients, 16-byte values), durable fsync unless stated. Throughput figures are the median of three 10 s runs (build-type rows: one run). They compare configurations on this laptop; they are not a claim about production hardware.

## Throughput and latency

| Cluster size (writes, 32 clients) | Throughput | Write p50 | Write p99 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 node | 3,694 ops/s | 8.0 ms | 31.8 ms |
| 3 nodes | 888 ops/s | 33.0 ms | 112.6 ms |
| 5 nodes | 688 ops/s | 42.1 ms | 142.3 ms |

| Reads vs writes (3 nodes, 8 clients, 50% writes) | p50 | p99 |
|---|---|---|
| Get (through the log) | 26.1 ms | 76.0 ms |
| Put | 25.1 ms | 64.2 ms |

## Under failure and by configuration

| Measurement | Result |
|---|---|
| Writes resume after `kill -9` of the leader (3 nodes, 5 kills) | median 314 ms, worst 333 ms |
| One follower stopped (`SIGSTOP`; stands in for a minority partition) | 872 ops/s, vs 888 with all three |
| Group commit: one fsync per batch vs per request | 859 vs 181 ops/s (**4.7×**) |
| Batching: up to 64 entries per `AppendEntries` vs 1 | 846 vs 36 ops/s (**23.4×**) |
| Durable fsync vs none (unsafe) | 895 vs 9,034 ops/s |
| Servers built release | 814 ops/s |
| Servers built asan+ubsan | 975 ops/s |
| Servers built tsan | 876 ops/s |
| 20% message drops (simulator, virtual time) | 18.5% of normal throughput |

## Snapshots

| State size | Take (serialize) | Restore | Save durably + compact |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1,000 keys | 0.08 ms | 0.17 ms | 16.86 ms |
| 10,000 keys | 0.72 ms | 1.97 ms | 22.93 ms |
| 100,000 keys | 7.06 ms | 16.93 ms | 28.90 ms |

One log append plus sync takes 3,902 µs with fsync and 10.7 µs without.

## Before and after the final improvements

Phase 9 measured the first complete version. Three changes followed: group commit, an adaptive client timeout, and PreVote/CheckQuorum.

| | Phase 9 | Now |
|---|---|---|
| Writes per second, 3 nodes, 32 clients | 210 ops/s | 888 ops/s |
| Write latency p50, 3 nodes, 32 clients | 154.6 ms | 33.0 ms |
| Write latency p99, 3 nodes, 32 clients | 200.5 ms | 112.6 ms |
| Writes resume after `kill -9` of the leader (median) | 495 ms | 314 ms |
| 20% message drops (simulated) | 5.2% of normal | 18.5% of normal |

## Predictions

Committed in [`raftkv.md`](../raftkv.md) §7 before anything was measured, and scored against the Phase 9 measurements, the version they were made about.

| Prediction | Measured | Verdict |
|---|---|---|
| 3 → 5 nodes costs about 25% of write throughput | 7.3% | ✗ wrong: much smaller |
| Writes resume within 1000 ms of `kill -9` of the leader | median 495 ms, worst 503 ms | ✓ held |
| Batching gives about 2× | 3.4× | ✗ wrong: underestimated |
